div.span:
Entry: python -m autoscout MATCH
or scripts/run_batch.py

tba.match(key)
teams by station, YouTube id, score breakdown

overlay.scan()
OCR clock + fuel counters + hub arrows, 3x/s

overlay.build_timeline()
match start, teleop start, clean counter series

views.detect_production()
FIRST template or Chezy: where the 3 camera views sit

pipeline.calibrate()
field.calibrate_view_dynamic per view:
AprilTags -> intrinsics + a pose every 4 s

pipeline.scan_video()
one pass over the match frames (see 4)

write output/KEY/
result.json, dets.json, hub_feats.json,
fuel_map.npy, scan.pkl

Exit: per-team fuel, points, auto paths
output/KEY/report.html
